name: Bard Ruairí

intro.text: A verse-off! Recite, and then we battle, and the crowd decides. Ready? 'There once was a bard of the market...' Your go. Then your team.

win: The crowd's spoken. They want yours. I want a lie down.
after: I've a limerick for every stall in this market. The cheese one's filthy. Ask me after the watershed.
